name: Charge
about: Finds and starts charging at Tesla Superchargers with your Tesla account.

settings.name: refreshToken
settings.label: Tesla refresh token
settings.obtain: A refresh token for Tesla's owner API (client ownerapi), made with a Tesla token tool such as the Auth for Tesla app or tesla_auth on a computer. The app rotates it as Tesla requires, so it keeps working once imported.

settings.name: mapsKey
settings.label: Maps key (optional)
settings.obtain: A Google Maps Platform key with the Geocoding API, for finding places typed into search. Without it, OpenStreetMap's Nominatim is used.

settings.name: geocodeEmail
settings.label: Contact email
settings.obtain: Optional: an address sent to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim with searches, as its usage policy asks.

settings.name: country
settings.label: Country
settings.obtain: Two-letter country code Tesla prices and finds chargers for.

settings.name: vehicle
settings.label: Vehicle
settings.obtain: NTSLA for a non-Tesla car charging at Superchargers; TSLA for a Tesla.

settings.name: appVersion
settings.label: Tesla app version
settings.obtain: The Tesla app version the requests claim to come from.

settings.name: userAgent
settings.label: Tesla user agent
settings.obtain: The x-tesla-user-agent header the requests send.

limits: Tesla's owner API is unofficial and can change without notice.

delta.about: Charge has always talked to Tesla directly; there is no Delta backend.
